kernel: V is inductive if 0 ∈ V and x ∈ V ⇒ S(x) ∈ V. Axiom 9: if V is inductive then ℕ ⊆ V. This rules out "too big" models and, combined with axioms 1–8, gives ℕ = {0,1,2,…} exactly. It is the same principle as Chapter 6.
objectives: Construct the {a,b} rogue model and see how Axiom 9 kills it
Connect Axiom 9 to the domino argument
